name: SkillsAndHobbies_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about skills or hobbies people want to learn.

sound_effects_config.default_background: calm home evening with occasional keyboard sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates discuss hobbies or skills they want to learn. They brainstorm together, sharing ideas and future learning plans.

setting.background: Assistant keeps track of skill ideas

scenario_template.topic: Someone mentions a skill they wish they had
scenario_template.note: Explaining why it sounds appealing. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
